detail.command:
set -euo pipefail

echo '=== STATUS ==='
git status --short

echo '=== DIFF CHECK VS MAIN ==='
git diff --check dac5a7f35580430ee8f57b214e3cd933a16ca1e6 b907d382e75b6955dbacaeb199fc2b2e1ebd1da2

echo '=== CHANGED FILES VS MAIN ==='
git diff --name-status dac5a7f35580430ee8f57b214e3cd933a16ca1e6 b907d382e75b6955dbacaeb199fc2b2e1ebd1da2

echo '=== TRACKED SECRET-LIKE FILE NAMES ==='
git ls-files | grep -Ei '(^|/)(\.env($|\.)|.*\.(pem|p12|pfx|key|mobileprovision)$|id_rsa|id_ed25519|secrets?\.)' || true

echo '=== POTENTIALLY DANGEROUS CODE FILES ==='
git grep -IlE 'child_process|exec(Sync)?\(|spawn(Sync)?\(|sudo |rm -rf|curl .*[|].*(sh|bash)|eval\(' -- '*.js' '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.json' '*.sh' || true

echo '=== ANDROID PERMISSIONS ==='
grep -n 'uses-permission' android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml || true

echo '=== IOS PRIVACY USAGE KEYS ==='
grep -nE 'NS[A-Za-z]+UsageDescription' ios/*/Info.plist || true

echo '=== TYPECHECK ==='
npm run typecheck

echo '=== TESTS ==='
npm test -- --runInBand

echo '=== LINT ==='
npm run lint

echo '=== IOS PRODUCTION JS BUNDLE ==='
rm -f /tmp/delete2-audit-main.jsbundle
npx react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output /tmp/delete2-audit-main.jsbundle >/tmp/delete2-audit-bundle.log 2>&1
wc -c /tmp/delete2-audit-main.jsbundle

echo '=== LIVE COINGECKO ==='
node -e "fetch('https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/markets?vs_currency=usd&ids=bitcoin,ethereum,solana,binancecoin,ripple&order=market_cap_desc&sparkline=false&price_change_percentage=24h').then(async r=>{console.log('HTTP',r.status); if(!r.ok) process.exit(2); const j=await r.json(); console.log(j.map(x=>x.symbol.toUpperCase()).join(',')); if(!j.some(x=>x.id==='bitcoin')) process.exit(3)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(4)})"

echo '=== FINAL STATUS ==='
git status --short
